# malariasimple

A fast, time-discrete compartmental approximation of
[malariasimulation](https://mrc-ide.github.io/malariasimulation/).

## Installation

You can install malariasimple from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("mrc-ide/malariasimple")
```

## Usage

Performing a model simulation in malariasimple is a two-step process:

``` r

library(malariasimple)
#1. Define model parameters
params <- get_parameters() |>
          set_equilibrium(init_EIR = 10)

#2. Run model
out <- run_simulation(params)
```

## Code Organisation

The model itself is written using
[odin2](https://mrc-ide.github.io/odin.dust/) and is found in two
scripts:

- `inst/odin/malariasimple_deterministic.R`
- `inst/odin/malariasimple_stochastic.R`

Customisations occur in the parameter set-up stage, which is facilitated
by the helper functions found in `R/`.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`get_custom()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/malariasimple/reference/get_custom.md)
  : Get more specific outputs
- [`get_custom_output()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/malariasimple/reference/get_custom_output.md)
  : Get more specific outputs
- [`get_daily_decay()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/malariasimple/reference/get_daily_decay.md)
  : Daily Effective Decay
- [`get_decay_mat()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/malariasimple/reference/get_decay_mat.md)
  : Decay matrix for ITN or SMC
- [`get_itn_usage_mat()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/malariasimple/reference/get_itn_usage_mat.md)
  : Produce matrix of population ITN usage
- [`get_output_colnames()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/malariasimple/reference/get_output_colnames.md)
  : Get column names for simulation output
- [`get_parameters()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/malariasimple/reference/get_parameters.md)
  : Create parameters for malariasimple
- [`get_peak_cc()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/malariasimple/reference/get_peak_cc.md)
  : Timing of peak carrying capacity
- [`get_seasonal_forcing()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/malariasimple/reference/get_seasonal_forcing.md)
  : Get daily seasonal forcing
- [`make_2d()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/malariasimple/reference/make_2d.md)
  : Converts 3D to long 2D
- [`malariasimple_deterministic`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/malariasimple/reference/malariasimple_deterministic.md)
  : Deterministic malaria model generator
- [`malariasimple_stochastic`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/malariasimple/reference/malariasimple_stochastic.md)
  : Stochastic malaria model generator
- [`parameter_draws_df`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/malariasimple/reference/parameter_draws_df.md)
  : Parameter draws (P. falciparum)
- [`run_simulation()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/malariasimple/reference/run_simulation.md)
  : Run deterministic malariasimple
- [`set_bednets()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/malariasimple/reference/set_bednets.md)
  : Set ITN parameters
- [`set_drug_params()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/malariasimple/reference/set_drug_params.md)
  : Set drug parameter defaults
- [`set_equilibrium()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/malariasimple/reference/set_equilibrium.md)
  : Set equilibrium
- [`set_rainfall_manual()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/malariasimple/reference/set_rainfall_manual.md)
  : Add manual rainfall forcing
- [`set_seasonality()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/malariasimple/reference/set_seasonality.md)
  : Add seasonal patterns
- [`set_smc()`](https://mrc-ide.github.io/malariasimple/reference/set_smc.md)
  : Set SMC parameters
